title: Convergence order of Euler, Velocity-Verlet and RK4 on a damped oscillator
ask: BENCHMARK. Run each integrator as its own setting: the protocol's grid has an axis `method` with the values euler, verlet and rk4. Declare a metric with id `convergence_order`: within one setting's run, the slope of log(|x(10) - exact x(10)|) against log(h) over h in {0.1, 0.05, 0.025}.

answers.source: forward Euler is first order (textbook); the benchmark's reference computation gives 1.16 over these steps (dev/evaluation/bench/reference.py::q1_orders), inside the tolerance
Velocity-Verlet is second order (textbook); reference computation 2.00
classical Runge-Kutta is fourth order (textbook); reference computation 3.95
